observed_problem: Profile Completeness can currently mark a mandatory initial obligation SATISFIED with empty discovery_ids and evidence_task_ids, and the Core has no separate authority proving that the Profile-owned Source Intake/search surface was adequately exercised. A weak or incomplete intake can therefore self-attest readiness even though collector success and discovered-record traceability do not prove coverage.
expected_behavior: Every mandatory Profile coverage obligation must have evidence-backed research/search disposition. SATISFIED must require authoritative support appropriate to that obligation, NEEDS_RESEARCH must fail closed, LIMITATION must preserve residual uncertainty, and NOT_APPLICABLE must be explicitly permitted by the Profile. Adequate negative search results may prove coverage without imposing fixed source/story quotas.
actual_behavior: schemas/profile-completeness-result.schema.json permits empty discovery/evidence arrays for every obligation status, and scripts/survey_completeness_v2.py does not require non-empty support for SATISFIED before overall READY can be accepted.
production_workaround: Do not approve or merge PR #310 and do not start W33/SP001. WU-012A must add Profile-owned coverage/search authority and evidence requirements before production validation.
improvement_action: Implement WU-012A: add Profile-owned Source Intake/search coverage authority including negative-result evidence, require authoritative support for SATISFIED, constrain NOT_APPLICABLE to Profile policy, and add fail-closed regression fixtures without fixed source-count or article-count quotas.
